The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert and helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs and even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits and vegetables!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Get ready for magical mayhem and manic missions with Joey and Boo! The chaos begins when they concoct a witch's brew that's too potent and transforms Boo into a giant four-eyed creature! Then, they find a magical phone on the ground and start taking selfies and playing music, but things quickly get out of hand. The magical mayhem continues when a pot of ink changes their color, turning them into fugitives on the run from the bug police!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Get ready for a wild ride of random antiks with Joey and Boo! The adventure begins when they take a leaf for a boat ride but get chased by a hungry fish. Then, they struggle to move a giant piece of candy until they eat some of it, giving them super speed! The random fun continues as Boo falls into a pot of invisible ink, they find a house made of gingerbread that a spider also wants and they discover a tiny toy racecar that takes them on a wild ride they can't control!

programme.title: Anguish
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Tess has suffered a pained past. She's been diagnosed with an assortment of mental ailments since her mother discovered her at a young age gruesomely banging her head against a wall. Now Tess's new medication seems to be working as she and her mother move to a new town seeking a fresh start. As Tess adjusts to her new life, horrific visions begin appearing of a deceased local girl, Lucy, recently killed in a grisly car accident. Hallucinations and physical manifestations intensify as Lucy's haunted spirit inhabits Tess's mind, body and soul. A local priest fears that it is Lucy attempting to return by taking control of the troubled Tess, and suggests exorcism as the only way to drive the dead girl out and bring peace to both of these tortured young souls.

He is married but is having a clandestine affair with one of the female doctors there named Yoo-gyeong. One day Yoo-gyeong has a muysterious accident and her hand is severed. But due to his quick action, Jung-woo is able to save her life and reattach her hand using a newly developed technology. The revolutionary surgery even improves Yoo-gyeong's health and she feels better than ever. But there are terrible side-effects as bizarre events begin to happen around her.

programme.title: X-Game
programme.desc: Based loosely on a horror novel, four kidnapped university students become entangled in a revenge story born out of past bullying. Hideaki took part in a bullying game in his elementary school called 'X Game' where unsuspecting victims picked their fates from a lottery list of pranks. Imprisoned together with three other classmates from the elementary school, they are made to play a new type of ' X Game .' This time around, however, the bullying is much, much worse.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: Ron is a travelling salesman who is superstitious. Each time he stays in a new hotel room, he would perform all steps needed to avoid offending any spirits, such as knocking the door and politely greeting the room before entering it. He would also cover any mirror that faces the bed. Yet, when he returns from a late-night dinner, the room still feels eerily strange.

programme.title: Bila Malam Pocong Menangis
programme.desc: 3 friends who are bike enthusiasts spend the night camping on a river bank in the forest. While having a good time, they are startled by an unusual sound. Upon paying attention, they realize it is the sound of someone crying. Joey, being the bravest of the trio, goes into the forest in the direction of the voice. Afraid of being left behind and not wanting to split up, Hazama and Celli have no choice but to follow suit. They finally trace the howling to its source. Joey shines his torchlight and the three friends are horrified to see a very ugly pocong crying in the middle of the forest.

The story begins when a newlywed couple Bima and Kanaya move into a home bought from an auction after its previous owners passed away. After a while, Kanaya begins to notice odd happenings occuring in their new home.

programme.title: Kerat 14
programme.desc: Haziq dan Nuzara merupakan pasangan kekasih dan Haziq amat menyayangi Nurzara, namun Haziq terlibat dengan aktiviti sosial dan tidak disenangi oleh Nuzara. Dalam masa yang sama Aril muncul dan mula tertarik dengan kecantikan Nuzara ketika Nuzara dan Haziq berada di salah sebuah kelab di Kuala Lumpur. Sebuah tragedi ngeri yang tidak disengajakan telah berlaku dalam kisah cinta Haziq dan Nuzara dan penyiasatan dilakukan oleh ASP Razman.

programme.title: Bldg. N
programme.desc: Shiori is a university student and she suffers from an extreme fear of death. Along with her schoolmates Keita and Maho, they scout a location for Keita's graduation film project. The location is an abandoned apartment complex that is infamous for paranormal sightings. The students meet the mysterious residents of the abandoned apartment complex. The residents believe that they are living with ghosts in the apartment. Keita and Maho become frightened and want to leave right away, but Shiori is sceptical and believes the supernatural phenomena are fake. She convinces her friends that they should investigate the claims.

programme.title: Kakak
programme.desc: Adi and Kirana have been married for a long time but are still childless. Kirana's body is weak due to her asthma and has experienced three miscarriages, causing stress and depression. They still live with Adi's mother, Aida, who doesn't approve of Kirana mostly because she's been unable to bear a child. Trying to relieve his wife's stress, Adi decides that a move to a neighborhood outside of town would be the best for them both. Kirana starts to feel that there is something strange with their new home, that something else is present with them.
